title: Antarctica, Bouvet Island, discovery map 1754.jpg
author: Philippe Buache
description: Map of the expedition of Jean-Baptiste Bouvet de Lozier, during which he discovered Bouvet Island in 1739. This map seems to be an improved second edition (published in 1754?) afer a first such map was published in 1739 immediatey after Bouvet's return to France. This 1739 map is also in Wikimedia Commons as: File:Antarctica, Bouvet Island, discovery map 1739.jpg . The French title of this new map
